column1: 22032§disintegrate§dɪsˈɪntɪgreɪt§The plane flew into a mountain and disintegrated on impact.§飞机冲向一座山，撞得**粉碎**。§
22033§fade§feɪd§His smile faded as he heard the answer.§听到这个答案，他脸上的笑容**渐渐消失**了。§
22034§concede§kənˈsiːd§The defeated side had to concede some of their territory to the enemy.§战败的一方不得不把部分领土**割让**给敌人。§
22035§complaint§kəmˈpleɪnt§My friend told me that he had gotten a kidney complaint.§我朋友对我说他肾**不舒服**。§
22036§irritable§ˈɪrɪtəbl§The old man was so irritable that he often jabbed his stick in his servant's face.§那个老人脾气太**暴躁**，经常用手杖戳佣人的脸。§

22037§legislation§ˌledʒɪsˈleɪʃn§The man called for legislation to adopt a unified response to the challenges posed by climate change and for the issue to receive more political support of the government.§此人呼吁通过**立法**，采取一致行动来应对气候变化带来的挑战，还呼吁政府给予该问题更多行政支持。§
22038§bouncing§ˈbaʊnsɪŋ§The new invention can put the bouncing person into a trance-like state and provide wonderful relaxation.§这项新发明能将**精力充沛**的人引入一种恍惚状态，给人带来愉悦的放松。§

22039§innovative§ˈɪnəveɪtɪv§Target pricing is an innovative approach used in the initial stages of the new-product development cycle to establish a contract price between a buyer and a seller.§目标定价法是在新产品开发环节的最初阶段，用来在买家和卖家之间建立合同价格的**新**方法。§

22040§congestion§kənˈdʒestʃən§Alleviation of mass illiteracy on a global scale is essential to that of health, hunger and other major world problems such as traffic congestion, environment pollution, etc.§在全球范围内大规模扫盲是缓解卫生、饥饿及其他重大世界性问题，如交通**堵塞**、环境污染等所不可或缺的条件。§
22041§particulate§pɑːˈtɪkjələt§Particulate matter in soils and aquatic systems reacts with and influences the biological activity of pesticides.§土壤和水系统中的**颗粒**物质与农药的生物活动起反应，并给其带来影响。§
22042§pollutant§pəˈluːtənt§There is a tax on all industrial pollutant emissions, not just those over state-prescribed standards.§所有工业**污染**排放物都要征税，而不仅仅是超出国家规定标准范围的污染物。§
22043§megacity§ˈmegəsɪti§For any megacity wishing to remain a sustainable social and economic development, healthy environment is a must.§对于任何一个想保持社会和经济可持续发展状态的**大城市**来说，良好的城市环境都是必不可少的。§

22044§allergic§əˈlɜːdʒɪk§If you're not sure what's triggering your allergic cough, your doctor can give you a skin test or blood test to pinpoint the allergen.§如果你不能确定是什么引发了**过敏性**咳嗽，医生可以为你进行皮肤测试或验血来确定过敏源。§
22045§populace§ˈpɒpjələs§Workers in the nuclear industry are more likely than the general populace to have cancer in accordance with some authoritative inquiry.§根据一些权威调查，从事核能行业的劳动者比普通**民众**更可能患癌症。§
22046§proclaim§prəˈkleɪm§It was the famous speech delivered by the President in which he proclaimed that the country was independent.§正是在那次著名演说中，总统**宣布**该国独立了。§改译文：删去句末排版残留「称）」
22047§supervision§ˌsuːpəˈvɪʒn§Students are prohibited from handling these chemicals unless they are under the supervision of a tutor.§学生们禁止接触这些化学药品，除非在老师的**指导**之下。§
22048§comparable§ˈkɒmpərəbl§A comparable apartment in the east of this city would cost twice as much.§一套**类似**的房子在城东部就要贵一倍。§

22049§habitual§həˈbɪtʃuəl§New curricula require teachers to alter not just their teaching concepts but also their habitual teaching methods and behaviors.§新课程要求教师不仅要改变教育理念，还要调整他们**习以为常**的教学方式和教学行为。§改例句：curricula 是复数，requires 改 require

22050§rehabilitate§ˌriːəˈbɪlɪteɪt§The prison service should try to rehabilitate prisoners rather than merely imprison them.§监狱服务应该尽力**改造**罪犯而不是单纯地羁押。§改例句：rather than 前后不平行，imprisonment 改 imprison them

22051§picturesque§ˌpɪktʃəˈresk§In addition to enjoying the picturesque scenery, travelers can visit quaint gift shops, country stores and other local attractions.§除了欣赏**如画**的美景，游客也可造访雅致的礼品店、乡村店铺和当地其他名胜。§
22052§afield§əˈfiːld§The private school enrolls students from Europe, Australia and even further afield.§这所私立学校招收来自欧洲、澳大利亚甚至更**远**地区的学生。§
22053§productive§prəˈdʌktɪv§Without irrigation many productive areas of the country would not be able to be farmed.§如果没有灌溉，这个国家的很多**多产**地区将不能进行农业生产。§
22054§form§fɔːm§You have to fill in a form, but it doesn't take long.§你得填写一张**表格**，但不会耽误太久。§
22055§temporary§ˈtemprəri§Coal mining makes only temporary use of the land and produces no toxic chemical wastes.§煤矿开采只是**暂时**使用这片土地，不会产生任何有毒的化学废弃物。§
22056§spill§spɪl§The beer spilled from the glass.§啤酒从玻璃杯里**溢出**来了。§
22057§mediocre§ˌmiːdiˈəʊkə(r)§I thought the play was only mediocre.§我认为这部戏剧只是**平庸**之作。§
22058§lead§liːd§The road will lead you into the college grounds.§这条路**通向**学院校区。§
22059§define§dɪˈfaɪn§Health in the physical sense has been defined as the absence of disease or illness.§就身体而言，健康的**意思是**不受疾病的困扰。§
22060§figure§ˈfɪgə(r)§The most recent available figures show that about a quarter of a million people are incapacitated with back pain every day.§最新**数字**显示，每天大约有25万人因受背部疼痛的折磨而无法正常工作与生活。§
22061§respond§rɪˈspɒnd§Companies should respond to this kind of situation in an honest and open way.§公司应该采取开诚布公的方式来**应对**这类情况。§
22062§approval§əˈpruːvl§Mining is subject to stringent controls and approval processes.§采矿要接受严格的管控和**审批**程序。§
22063§smell§smel§Flowers smell stronger in the late evening.§花**香**在深夜更加浓烈。§
22064§flaw§flɔː§The worst flaw in this document was the naive faith it embodied.§这份文献最大的**缺点**就是它所表达的思想太天真了。§
22065§multiple§ˈmʌltɪpl§Those devices have multiple purposes.§那些装置具备**多重**功能。§
22066§adventure§ədˈventʃə(r)§Hypotheses are adventures of the mind.§假定是思想的**冒险**。§
22067§zone§zəʊn§There are many different climatic zones in Australia.§澳大利亚有很多不同的气候**带**。§
22068§diagram§ˈdaɪəgræm§He tossed the diagram of the bridge to Brian.§他把桥的**结构图**扔给了布莱恩。§
22069§slouch§slaʊtʃ§Studies have shown that just one hour sitting in a slouched position can strain ligaments in the back.§研究表明，保持**懒散**的坐姿一小时就会导致背部韧带受损。§
22070§bloom§bluːm§By the time the flowers bloom, the new queens will be laying eggs.§鲜花**盛开**之时，新的蜂王便会产卵。§
22071§horizon§həˈraɪzn§It is in technology and commerce that glass has widened its horizons.§玻璃在技术和商业领域扩大了应用**范围**。§
22072§trick§trɪk§They used a decoy camera to trick burglars.§他们用一台伪装相机来**哄骗**窃贼。§
22073§centigrade§ˈsentɪgreɪd§This substance has a relatively high ignition temperature of 182 degrees centigrade.§这种物质的燃点相对较高，达到182**摄氏**度。§
22074§courageous§kəˈreɪdʒəs§The message behind a half handshake is that "I'm not a strong or courageous person."§握手时只握住手指，其暗含的信息是：“我不是强者或**有胆量**的人。”§改例句：英文句中的中文引号改为英文引号
22075§academic§ˌækəˈdemɪk§Once in higher education, you can apply for a loan at any time in the academic year.§进入高校以后，你就可以在**学**年内的任何时间申请贷款。§
22076§preferable§ˈprefrəbl§I'm not sure the cure is preferable to the disease.§我不太确定这种疗法是否比疾病本身**更可取**。§改译文：原译文把句意理解错了（句子说的是疗法未必比疾病本身好），按原意重译
22077§biometrics§ˌbaɪəʊˈmetrɪks§Biometrics is a little-known but fast-growing technology.§**生物测定**是一门鲜为人知但发展迅速的技术。§
22078§reunite§ˌriːjuːˈnaɪt§The lost child was reunited with his parents in the police station.§那个走失的孩子和他的父母在警察局**重聚**了。§
22079§minority§maɪˈnɒrəti§Human resources are in the minority as much of the work is done by automated machines controlled by computers.§许多工作被电脑控制的自动化机器完成，人力就占**少数**了。§
22080§clench§klentʃ§The doctor told him to relax and not to clench his hands like that.§医生告诉他放松，别像那样**紧握**拳头。§
22081§corpus§ˈkɔːpəs§We have an existing written corpus of language learning materials in the library.§图书馆里有现成的关于语言学习的书面**资料**。§
22082§alarm§əˈlɑːm§Every time when you leave your house, make sure the windows and doors are shut, and set the burglar alarm.§每次出门时都应确定门窗已关好，并打开防盗**警铃**。§
22083§beam§biːm§The little girl beamed a warm smile at him.§那个小女孩冲他热情地**微笑**。§
22084§conjunction§kənˈdʒʌŋkʃn§Seat belts are more effective when used in conjunction with air bags.§安全带和安全气囊**一起**使用，效果更好。§
22085§height§haɪt§Many characteristics, such as height and intelligence, result from subtle interactions between genes and the environment.§许多特征，如**身高**和智力，都是基因和环境间相互微妙作用的结果。§
22086§nasty§ˈnɑːsti§Many people feel that it's dangerous to ride the subway—there have been some nasty attacks.§很多人认为乘坐地铁很危险，因为地铁上发生过一些**可怕**的袭击。§
22087§monster§ˈmɒnstə(r)§The moving van is a monster of a truck.§这辆搬家车是辆**巨型**卡车。§
22088§continually§kənˈtɪnjuəli§The diver was continually fascinated by the beauty of the sea.§潜水者**一直**陶醉于大海的美丽。§
22089§adequate§ˈædɪkwət§Good living habits and adequate health care are critical factors of governing health.§良好的生活习惯和**适当**的卫生保健是保持健康的关键因素。§
22090§hike§haɪk§My classmates want to hike through the forest in summer.§我们班同学想在夏天**徒步**穿越森林。§
22091§grateful§ˈgreɪtfl§I'd be grateful if you could tell me a little about your time since you've been here in Cambridge.§如果你能够说说来剑桥以后的一些情况，我将不胜**感激**。§
22092§organ§ˈɔːgən§The main organs of communication for the WSPU (Women's Social and Political Union) were its two newspapers.§妇女社会与政治联盟的主要联络**机构**是其创办的两家报纸。§改例句：英文句中的中文括号改为英文括号
22093§rely§rɪˈlaɪ§Most inland farmers rely on underground water for irrigation.§大部分内陆农民都**依靠**地下水灌溉土地。§
22094§incentive§ɪnˈsentɪv§Hypotheses provide the initiative and incentive for the inquiry.§假设**促使**人们主动去调查。§
22095§technical§ˈteknɪkl§This job requires someone with specialized technical knowledge.§该工作要求从业者具备专门的**技术**知识。§
22096§chorus§ˈkɔːrəs§The chorus usually plays a large part in the music festival.§**合唱**在音乐节上通常扮演着重要的角色。§
